components.name: Liberation Fonts
components.usage: Metric-compatible substitutes for Helvetica/Arial (Sans), Times/Times New Roman (Serif) and Courier/Courier New (Mono), regular, bold, italic and bold italic.

components.name: DejaVu Sans
components.usage: Substitute for the Symbol and ZapfDingbats standard fonts (Greek, mathematical operators, arrows and the Dingbats block).
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2003 Bitstream, Inc.; DejaVu changes are in the public domain

components.name: Noto Sans JP, Noto Sans SC, Noto Sans TC, Noto Sans KR
components.version: google/fonts commit 6c1dbe27dcf7d817d4b62cec033ba77fa8e2a5ec (default instance of the variable fonts)
components.usage: Outlines for non-embedded Adobe-Japan1, Adobe-GB1, Adobe-CNS1 and Adobe-Korea1 fonts, converted to the compact chunk format described in CjkChunkCodec (glyph outlines only, split per 256-scalar Unicode block).
components.copyright: Copyright 2014-2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/), with Reserved Font Name 'Source'
components.notes: Derived data (outlines re-encoded, subset to the legacy GB2312, JIS X 0208/CP932, Big5 and KS X 1001 repertoires) uses no Reserved Font Name and is not distributed as a font.

components.name: Adobe Core 14 AFM metrics
components.usage: Glyph advance widths and the built-in Symbol/ZapfDingbats encodings embedded in PortableDocument.Content (Resources/std14-widths.bin); numeric facts only, no outlines.
components.embeddedIn: PortableDocument.Content (Resources/std14-widths.bin; the notice also ships there as Resources/std14-notice.txt)
components.copyright: Copyright (c) Adobe Systems Incorporated. All Rights Reserved. Years per AFM file: Helvetica 1985, 1987, 1989, 1990, 1997; Times 1985, 1987, 1989, 1990, 1993, 1997; Courier 1989-1993, 1997 (Bold variants omit 1992); Symbol 1985, 1987, 1989, 1990, 1997; ZapfDingbats 1985, 1987, 1988, 1989, 1997.
components.source: https://github.com/apache/pdfbox/tree/trunk/pdfbox/src/main/resources/org/apache/pdfbox/resources/afm (widths verified identical to the published Core 14 AFMs also mirrored at https://github.com/pdf-raku/Font-AFM-raku/tree/master/etc/Core14_AFMs)
